stemMd: A proposal has three independent benefits. A critic shows that one claimed benefit is unlikely and concludes that there is no reason at all to adopt the proposal. The critic has

options.label: A
options.textMd: failed to address the other independent reasons supporting adoption.

options.label: B
options.textMd: confused an outcome with its probability.

options.label: C
options.textMd: proved that every claimed benefit is false.

options.label: D
options.textMd: assumed all three benefits must occur simultaneously.

options.label: E
options.textMd: shown that benefits cannot justify proposals.

explanationMd: Defeating one reason removes that reason, not every other reason. Since the benefits are stipulated to be independent, the critic must address the remaining support before concluding that no reason for adoption exists.

distractorRationale.e: No such general principle is established.
distractorRationale.d: The critic does not explicitly defend a conjunctive requirement.
distractorRationale.b: The primary gap is the unaddressed independent support.
